features.title: Recurring Income

features.title: Flexible Liquidity
features.description: Buy or sell fractions under transparent market rules.

faqs.question: How do I get started with BRIDS?
faqs.answer: Sign up, complete verification, and select a fractional property from the main dashboard.

faqs.question: What is the minimum investment?
faqs.answer: You can start with low amounts depending on the property, with progressive diversification.

faqs.question: How are returns distributed?
faqs.answer: The platform calculates and distributes passive income according to your fractional participation.
